summaryZh: Thackray 实验室研究多囊卵巢综合征的病因与病理生理，关注肠道微生物组、代谢及生殖轴之间的相互作用。研究也涉及类固醇激素如何调节肠道微生物组的性别差异，并使用相关动物模型。
researchQuestions: 多囊卵巢综合征的病因和病理生理机制是什么？
类固醇激素在调节肠道微生物组性别差异中起什么作用？

evidence.quote: Dr. Varykina Thackray, Ph.D. Professor, Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences Associate Director, UCSD Center for Obstetrics and Gynecology Research Innovation Department Mentor Co-Director, UCSD Health Sciences Faculty Mentor Training Program Read Full Bio Thackray Lab Highlight Meet Dr. Thackray, a Reproductive Sciences Leader, and her Research Team Investigating the Role of the Microbiome in Women's Health Fimbria News » About the Lab One objective of our research is to understand the etiology and pathophysiology of PCOS using relevant animal models. We are currently studying interactions among the gut microbiome, metabolism and the reproductive axis in PCOS. Another objective is to understand the role of steroid hormones in regulating sex differences in the gut microbiome which impact many physiological processes and are implicated in diseases with sex bias including reproductive, metabolic, autoimmune, and neurological disorders. Thackray Lab – At the Thackray Lab, their research is focused on understanding the etiology and pathophysiology of PCOS using relevant mouse and tissue culture models.
One objective of our research is to understand the etiology and pathophysiology of PCOS using relevant animal models.

Another objective is to understand the role of steroid hormones in regulating sex differences in the gut microbiome which impact many physiological processes and are implicated in diseases with sex bias including reproductive, metabolic, autoimmune, and neurological disorders.
